observed_donor_mechanism: Generated machine-readable documentation entrypoints let agents consume a compact projection without making that projection authoritative.
field_transform: Generate one compact revision-bound /llms.txt transcript from CURRENT + manifest + WAITING + FIELD INDEX contract; mark it non-canonical and fail CI when it drifts.
stop: No llms-full dump and no second context database. Expand only if an external agent demonstrably needs a missing channel.
